title: 5-inch FPV drone frame
summary: carbon plates, lofted props, router check
description: A true-X freestyle quadcopter frame for 5 to 5.3 inch props, CNC routed from 2 mm and 5 mm carbon fibre sheet, with purple anodised standoffs, a 30.5 mm stack, a cage for a 19 mm camera and real 5.1 x 4.3 x 3 props lofted at their pitch.
process: CNC routing of carbon fibre sheet

difficulty.rationale: Lofted freeform props through table-driven sections on formula datum planes with washout, Steiner router proofs over four parts, a 45 deg datum layout, multi-body clearance and a centrifugal-stress check, kernel limits navigated.

standards: 30.5 x 30.5 mm M3 flight controller mounting
16 and 19 mm M3 motor bolt circles
materials: Carbon fibre (CFRP) sheet, 2 mm and 5 mm

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: deep document.check ok with its own 32 assertions, check-range 11 points; wheelbase 225.62 mm, frame 104.71 g, props 4.13 g each, clearance 3.717 mm, root stress 47.8 MPa, all as this example's; Steiner router checks exact; about 400 commands. It read the camera plate's relief notch and pivot a little differently (its first notch was narrower than the bit, which the Steiner check caught).
